org.en: Music and AI Lab, National Taiwan University
org.zh: 臺灣大學 Music and AI Lab

text.en: A bilingual, lyric-aligned audio-to-lead-sheet transcription pipeline that extracts melody, chords, beats, meter, and musical structure from full-song audio, with beat tracking, pitch correction, and rhythm quantization evaluated to improve quality. Accepted for presentation at ISMIR 2026 Late-Breaking/Demo.
text.zh: 雙語、歌詞對齊的音訊轉主旋律譜（lead sheet）採譜流程，從整首歌曲擷取旋律、和弦、拍點、拍號與段落結構，並評估拍點追蹤、音高校正與節奏量化以提升採譜品質。已獲 ISMIR 2026 Late-Breaking/Demo 接受發表。

title.en: Lyrics-to-Song Generation with MIDI-LLM and MIDI-SAG
title.zh: 以 MIDI-LLM 與 MIDI-SAG 進行歌詞生成歌曲

text.en: An end-to-end, lyrics-conditioned song generation pipeline that connects symbolic lead-sheet generation with arrangement and audio synthesis. Fine-tuning language models to generate melody, chords, rhythm, and lyric-aligned symbolic representations, including syllable-level lyric pointers, phonetic information, rests, breaths, and many-to-many lyric–note alignment for controllable generation.
text.zh: 端到端、以歌詞為條件的歌曲生成流程，串接符號主旋律譜生成、編曲與音訊合成。微調語言模型以生成旋律、和弦、節奏與歌詞對齊的符號表示，包含音節層級的歌詞指標、發音資訊、休止、換氣，以及多對多的歌詞與音符對齊，以實現可控生成。

title.en: A Dual Evaluation for Music Transcription
title.zh: A Dual Evaluation for Music Transcription

text.en: A dual evaluation framework for notation accuracy and performance fidelity in automatic music transcription: 24 pipelines (eight audio-to-MIDI models × three MIDI-to-score systems) on 230 piano performances, an audio-only listening study with 106 participants and 3,180 pairwise judgments, and a comparison of human preferences with notation-based, signal-processing, and learned audio similarity metrics.
text.zh: 同時評估自動採譜「樂譜正確性」與「演奏擬真度」的雙重評估框架：在 230 段鋼琴演奏上評估 24 種流程（8 個音訊轉 MIDI 模型 × 3 個 MIDI 轉樂譜系統），設計並分析 106 位受試者、3,180 筆成對比較的純音訊聽測，並比較人類偏好與基於樂譜、訊號處理及學習式音訊相似度的指標。

text.en: Structured audio-language-model rubric rewards for text-to-music post-training: preference pairs for DPO on MusicGen-small and ACE-Step v1, and scalar rewards with DiffusionNFT on ACE-Step. Rubric rewards gave broad gains on independent perceptual and objective metrics, while specialized rewards worked better for precise musical attributes.
text.zh: 以音訊語言模型的結構化評分標準（rubric）作為文字生成音樂的後訓練獎勵：為 MusicGen-small 與 ACE-Step v1 建構 DPO 偏好資料對，並在 ACE-Step 上以 DiffusionNFT 使用純量獎勵。Rubric 獎勵在獨立的感知與客觀指標上帶來全面提升，而針對精確音樂屬性時，專門的獎勵效果更好。

org.en: Ubiquitous Computing Lab, University of Washington
org.zh: 華盛頓大學 Ubiquitous Computing Lab

text.en: Lightweight neural networks for real-time gesture recognition on resource-constrained embedded devices, including model quantization and deployment for on-device inference.
text.zh: 在資源受限的嵌入式裝置上，以輕量神經網路進行即時手勢辨識，包含模型量化與裝置端推論部署。

title.zh: 以咳嗽音訊篩檢結核病

text.en: Transformer-based models, including the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) and MobileViT, for cough-based tuberculosis risk classification.
text.zh: 使用 Audio Spectrogram Transformer（AST）與 MobileViT 等 Transformer 架構，從咳嗽音訊進行結核病風險分類。

text.en: Machine learning models for detecting cough events and localizing them in time within continuous audio recordings.
text.zh: 在連續音訊錄音中偵測咳嗽事件並定位其時間位置的機器學習模型。

title.zh: 軟體開發工程師實習生

text.en: Designed and implemented firmware for inter-chip communication, camera-module integration, and Wi-Fi connectivity validation on smart-home devices.
text.zh: 為智慧家庭裝置設計並實作晶片間通訊、相機模組整合與 Wi-Fi 連線驗證的韌體。

text.en: Board-level integration and debugging across embedded hardware, firmware, camera modules, and network interfaces.
text.zh: 跨嵌入式硬體、韌體、相機模組與網路介面的板級整合與除錯。

text.en: Automated unit tests and peripheral mock frameworks for validating firmware across hardware states, improving test coverage and reducing regression risk.
text.zh: 建立自動化單元測試與周邊模擬框架，在各種硬體狀態下驗證韌體，提升測試覆蓋率並降低回歸風險。

text.en: Analyzed LLaMA 2/3, CodeLlama, Falcon, Mistral, Mixtral, Breeze, Whisper, and Vicuna, focusing on attention architectures, model scaling, and memory requirements.
text.zh: 分析 LLaMA 2/3、CodeLlama、Falcon、Mistral、Mixtral、Breeze、Whisper 與 Vicuna，著重於注意力架構、模型規模與記憶體需求。

text.zh: 使用多 GPU Linux 環境與群聯 AI SSD 系統進行模型訓練與實驗。
